name: Oboe
author: Versilian Studios (samples); DAW build script
attribution: Versilian Studios VSCO-2 Community Edition (Sam Gossner / Versilian Studios), CC0 1.0
desc: Oboe, sustained non-vibrato, 2 dynamics. Nasal, plaintive, cutting. Range Bb3-G6. Solo melodies, pastoral themes, doubling strings. | Playable MIDI 58-91 (A#3-G6), 2 velocity layers crossfaded. Params: human 0-1 (timing/level/pitch life), velcurve (velocity response), keytrack/bright (tone follows pitch/velocity). Legato melody: overlap consecutive notes by ~30 ms (next note starts before the previous ends) with glide 0.03-0.06; wide leaps crossfade naturally (legato=1), legato=0 = pure slide.
